adjudication.rationale: The diff adds two new controller specs: `spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb` and `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb`. Each contains only a single example asserting the controller class inherits from `Admin::AdminController`, and does not exercise any controller actions. In particular, there are no tests for `create/update/destroy` in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, no test of the uncategorized fallback in `save_host`, and no tests around behavior when the record lookup returns nil. There is also no spec covering the migration’s conversion of old `site_settings` values into `embeddable_hosts` rows. This is a verifiable lack of meaningful test coverage introduced in the diff.
